title_zh: S01 众智园可撤物理验证：P0 空间—运营—复位参考
title_en: S01 Zhongzhiyuan reversible physical validation: P0 space-operation-reset reference
purpose: One participant-authored reference for reviewing a minimum reversible S01 condition. It is not a survey, approval, construction drawing, operating authorisation, cost plan, or field-performance record.

scope.area_typology: Zhongzhiyuan validation type; no parcel, carrier, or field location is asserted

envelope.value: 12 m x 9 m zero-coordinate conceptual envelope

why_space_people.why: A real, bounded physical task may require a supervised separation and reset edge that ordinary simulation or meeting rooms cannot provide.
why_space_people.ordinary_city_floor: Public route, ordinary training/work, maintenance access, human help and non-digital fallback remain first and cannot be displaced.

zone_logic.name: ordinary route
zone_logic.rule: No walk-in queue or task occupancy; remains legible and continuous.

zone_logic.name: handoff
zone_logic.rule: A human steward confirms the conditional boundary before any task state.

zone_logic.name: removable test
zone_logic.rule: One bounded active task/device only; no autonomous public-space activity.

zone_logic.name: authority/operator
zone_logic.rule: Separated safety and operating decisions are visible at the threshold.

zone_logic.name: booked observer
zone_logic.rule: Observation is booked, supervised and non-queueing.

zone_logic.name: maintenance/reset
zone_logic.rule: Inventory, isolation and quarantine route stay available before and after a session.

zone_logic.name: variable professional buffer
zone_logic.rule: Extent is null until future competent professional assessment.

stop_reset_maintenance.fail_close_rule: Any missing gate, unsafe state, route conflict, stale authority or incomplete role separation yields P0_GO=false.
stop_reset_maintenance.issue_state: QUARANTINED until an independent reset and ordinary-baseline verification is complete.
stop_reset_maintenance.maintenance_rule: No new session follows a failed close, incomplete inventory, or missing reset record.

cost_and_alternatives.rom_opex_expression: Relative sensitivity only; any future amount requires source-bounded quotation, authorisation and a named responsible party.
alternatives: NO-BUILD: simulation, review and ordinary carrier
cost_and_alternatives.selection_rule: P0 does not proceed when an alternative preserves the ordinary-city floor with less impact, or verified physical need is absent.

external_hold_gates: bounded real task and accountable task owner

acceptance_and_handoff.handoff_record: dated gate register, stop/reset record, inventory state and independent ordinary-baseline verification
